lines.t: (Verse 1)
Your love is so perfect, Your love is so true.
That You gave Your life after all we did to You.
You sacrificed Yourself so we could be set free,
You gave Yourself because You loved me.
(Pre-Chorus)
YahuShua, even while on the cross,
You remembered each of us by name.
(Chorus)
Hands stretched wide upon the tree.
Pierced in Your side.
Blood poured out to rescue me,
Love shown that couldn't hide.
When I think of what You did,
I know I will forever love You.
Because You loved me so much too.
(Verse 2)
My heart loves You so strongly,
Because You gave Your life for all of us,
Even when we treated You wrongly.
I see the love in Your hands and feet.
You took the weight of all my sin,
And gave Your life for me.
(Chorus)
Hands stretched wide upon the tree.
Pierced in Your side.
Blood poured out to rescue me,
Love shown that couldn't hide.
When I think of what You did,
I know I will forever love You.
Because You loved me so much too.
(Bridge)
Worthy is the Lamb who died for us,
Worthy is the One who set us free.
Then death was overcome
When the stone was rolled away.
(Outro)
Hands stretched wide,
Love shown that day.
In every possible way.
Hands stretched wide,
Love shown that day.
In every possible way.
